title: Two unit orientations of the same subspace agree up to sign
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Q a subspace of ℝ^P, and ξ₁, ξ₂ ∈ Λₙ(ℝ^P) (the contract's MultiVector P n) both unit orientations of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξᵢ Q: there are an orthonormal family τ⁽ⁱ⁾ : Fin n → ℝ^P spanning Q and a sign with ξᵢ(α) = ±α(τ⁽ⁱ⁾) for all n-covectors α). Then ξ₂ = ξ₁ or ξ₂ = −ξ₁.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₁ Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₂ Q → ξ₂ = ξ₁ ∨ ξ₂ = -ξ₁
